newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens against dollar and stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens against dollar and stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened against both the dollar and sterling on Tuesday reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at a commercial mean rate of 20.4705 to the dollar from 20.374 on Monday, and at a commercial mean rate of 33.2245 to sterling, from 33.0155 on Monday.
Forex dealers said the dollar strengthened against European currencies in overnight international markets.
Dealers added that the central bank sold dollars in the interbank forex market on Monday mid afternoon at four cents above the prevailing interbank rate.
"The market is quiet presently after central bank's intervention on Monday," a dealer said.
